before_request_gate: Authenticate original archive; fresh baseline tests pass; unchanged candidate test outcomes retained; same frozen selected failure and happy-path controls reproduced
editing_boundary: One unique old_text/new_text replacement in InventoryStore.java; complete result must equal supplied healthy baseline bytes; all tests/peer/oracle and other guards unchanged
verification: Unchanged Java tests, same selected/control action sequences, three baseline/candidate pairs per plan per stage, same fresh runtime images within stages
stop: One proposal; preserve any rejection/test/verification error; no fallback repair or outcome-seeking rerun
claim: Known author-prepared JUnit-caught defect; healthy answer supplied; bounded restoration, not unfamiliar repair or general self-healing
